subject: Geografia
description_pt: Relacionar a produção de lixo doméstico ou da escola aos problemas causados pelo consumo excessivo e construir propostas para o consumo consciente, considerando a ampliação de hábitos de redução, reúso e reciclagem/ descarte de materiais consumidos em casa, na escola e/ou no entorno.

components.description_pt: Relacionar a produção de resíduos domésticos ou escolares aos problemas causados pelo consumo excessivo
components.description_en: Relate the production of household or school waste to problems caused by excessive consumption
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a technological solution based on its potential to minimize waste and ecosystem degradation

components.description_pt: Desenvolver propostas de consumo consciente incorporando hábitos de redução, reutilização e reciclagem de materiais
components.description_en: Develop proposals for conscious consumption incorporating habits of reducing, reusing, and recycling materials
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effectiveness of specific individual or community actions in reducing environmental impact

components.description_pt: Identificar práticas adequadas para descartar materiais consumidos em casa, escola e comunidade
components.description_en: Identify appropriate practices for disposing of materials consumed at home, school, and in the community

cc_matches.description: Scientists and engineers can make major contributions by developing technologies that produce less pollution and waste and that preclude ecosystem degradation.
Things that people do to live comfortably can affect the world around them. But they can make choices that reduce their impacts on the land, water, air, and other living things.
